title: Overhaul Mobile Mode Shell Chrome
description:
Mobile mode (viewport ≤767px) is massively incomplete: navbar/footer still render all six per-anchor PanelChromeTabBars plus the fullscreen toggle, the merged MobilePanel is a fixed 260px strip instead of filling the screen, windows keep their Focus/maximize control, and panes stay draggable/resizable/foldable.

Target: navbar shows only logo+title and a single "Panel" toggle top-right; toggling opens the merged panel to fill the full space between navbar and footer (canvas hidden but mounted); footer keeps brand credits but drops its tab bars; windows lose the Focus control (always full space, Close stays); the 8-anchor Pane API becomes fixed (no drag/resize/fold) on mobile; no document-fullscreen toggle on mobile. Example selector and mode switcher move into a synthetic "App" tab inside the mobile panel.

Implementation plan (approved, see full plan for exact regions/line numbers):
- ui/js/react/index.tsx: add UiMobileProvider/useUiMobile context+hook; Layout mobile branch fills MobilePanel to flex-1 and hides (not unmounts) canvas; MobilePanel drops fixed height; Pane reads useUiMobile to disable drag/resize/fold; Mode/ModeDockTabBar hides Focus control on mobile (Close stays); Window suppresses focus control via useUiMobile; add ui.mobilePanel.toggle/app i18n keys (EN/DE) + resolveControlLabelId branch.
- framework/renderer/react/index.tsx (FrameworkOsShell): add dedicated unpersisted mobilePanelVisible state + SET_MOBILE_PANEL_VISIBLE action, route all mobile-relevant panel-visibility writers (hotkeys, command palette, introduction, details/studio override effects) through it instead of the derived "any anchor visible"; mobile-only navbarItems branch (logo+title + single Panel toggle, no tab bars/fullscreen/example/mode); append example selector + mode switcher as a synthetic "App" tree leaf to mobilePanelTabs on mobile; mobile-only footerItems branch (credits only, no tab bars); showFullscreenToggle={!mobile}.
- Extend existing stories (.storybook/stories/ui/MobilePanel.stories.tsx, Layout.stories.tsx — add Mobile story) and inline vitest blocks in ui/js/react/index.tsx (Mode mobile, Pane, Shell components describes) — no new files.

Verification: bunx vitest run on ui/js/react/index.tsx; Storybook check; runtime check via OS shell dev server at 375x812 viewport confirming all 6 target behaviors plus no WebGL context loss when toggling canvas visibility and correct desktop restoration above 767px.
summary:
Overhauled mobile mode shell chrome to match desktop parity of functionality (previously just a fixed 260px strip with all desktop chrome still rendered underneath).

Changes:
- Navbar (mobile): collapses to logo+title on the left and a single "Panel" toggle on the right — no per-anchor PanelChromeTabBars, no fullscreen toggle, no example selector/mode switcher inline. The example selector and mode switcher now render inside a synthetic "App" tab appended to the merged mobile panel's tab list (framework.mobile.app), sharing the exact same elements the desktop navbar renders (single source of truth).
- Panel: MobilePanel now fills the full flex-1 space between navbar and footer (dropped the fixed height prop) instead of a 260px strip. Visibility is driven by a new dedicated `mobilePanelVisible` shell state + `SET_MOBILE_PANEL_VISIBLE` action (not persisted — mobile always boots canvas-first), replacing the old "any anchor visible" derivation which could auto-open the panel from stale desktop-persisted anchor state. All panel-visibility writers (hotkeys, command palette arg-carrying commands, introduction walkthrough, studio/details tab overrides) branch on mobile to route through the mobile panel state/path instead of per-anchor dispatches.
- Canvas: stays mounted but gets a `hidden` class while the mobile panel is open, so the WASM/3D world isn't torn down and replugged on every toggle.
- Footer: keeps brand credits but drops its three PanelChromeTabBars on mobile.
- Windows: the Mode window-stack's Focus/Unfocus control is hidden on mobile (windows always take full space); Close stays. The standalone Window component also suppresses its own focus control via a new `useUiMobile()` hook for direct (non-Mode) consumers.
- Panes (8-anchor Pane API): fixed on mobile — no drag handle, no resize handle, folding disabled (content always shown).
- Added `UiMobileProvider`/`useUiMobile()` context+hook in ui-react so components without a `mobile` prop (Pane, Window) can read the shell's authoritative mobile flag, falling back to the media query for standalone usage.
- Added `ui.mobilePanel.toggle`/`ui.mobilePanel.app` i18n labels (EN/DE) plus a resolveControlLabelId branch.

Verification: targeted vitest run (mobile|Mobile|Pane|Focus filter) in ui-react passed 43/46 tests (the 3 failures are pre-existing, unrelated ShellDisplayPanel/ShellSettingsPanel Select-rendering issues, confirmed present before and unaffected by these changes). framework-renderer-react's full suite passed 192/192. Storybook visual verification of the new Layout "Mobile" story was attempted but could not be completed — the dev server repeatedly failed/died under sustained heavy CPU contention (load average 11-14) from another concurrent session's vitest runs on the shared machine; this is an environment resource issue, not a defect in the change.
